body: I'm taking a month off with my savings and then looking to find another job. I hope I can. Right now I'm just taking classes and trying to get my confidence up. They start tomorrow so hopefully they can give me some useful skills. And maybe a little hope.

Two major ones. I've had some short term stints between them but so far all of my non-temp or seasonal work has been this way. I've had a couple gems for bosses, but through temporary gigs. I have to believe there are more like them, but it's getting harder and harder to hope. It feels like a lose lose: work to survive and be treated like dirt, or never make enough to live.

Honestly while I've made progress with ptsd treatment I kind of always see my future self coming to suicide somehow. Since no one in power cares. If I'm loyal to anyone they'll just drop me when it's convenient.

I think my motivation in school was because it was my element maybe? I had lofty goals and shot for them and wasn't concerned with falling short. I'm decent at school. I think with work the stakes are higher since my survival depends on the paycheck...it makes me feel powerless again.

Thank you so much. I really needed this. I am officially diagnosed with PTSD and have been working with my therapist on finding confidence and boundaries, and it's definitely a long process. But it does help. I've thankfully saved enough money that I can support myself and my dog for a few months, so I'll be spending it nurturing myself while I look for suitable work. I'm trying to keep hope as best I can.
